A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TRIDENT study. The complete main text, Figures 1–10, Tables 1–17, and Appendices A–B are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original dataset analyses, model fine-tuning evaluations, jailbreak experiments, human assessments, and ablations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including safety and helpfulness evaluations, human assessments, and diversity ablations.

M1.justification: The scenario/persona generation pipeline, six jailbreak methods, instruction filtering, and CoT-based response generation remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix B.2.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 14 intent domains, training datasets, safety benchmarks, language coverage, and helpfulness evaluation. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain identical comparator sets: AART, ATTAQ, HH_RLHF, SAFE_RLHF, WILDBREAK, WILDCHAT, unaligned models, and the six jailbreak methods. The WILDBREAK comparisons for Gemma and Mistral are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the 3,000-example alignment subsets, seven-epoch LoRA training, evaluated models, HS/ASR/HPR metrics, and human-evaluation procedures. Ablation controls and the Appendix A.2 helpfulness protocol are unchanged.

E4.justification: The lexical, malicious-intent, and jailbreak-tactic ablations in Tables 8–9 and Figures 3 and 10 are retained unchanged. Appendix intent-distribution and clustering analyses are also identical.

E5.justification: The experimental descriptions and numerical and graphical reporting contain no changes to repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty reporting, or statistical testing.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match throughout, including the appendices. For example, Table 4 retains TRIDENT-EDGE's Harmbench HS of 1.64 and ASR of 0.02 in both versions.

T1.justification: No mathematical definitions, formal assumptions, or derivations are revised. Neither version introduces formal theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about three-dimensional diversity, the TRIDENT datasets, and safety/helpfulness benefits. The new Author Contributions section assigns author roles without changing the research contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of diversity benefits, cross-model generalization, and helpfulness remain unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning the 8B generator and evolving jailbreak methods.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, generation and filtering instructions, the Appendix B.2 response template, and the dataset repository link are unchanged. The new authorship information adds no technical reproduction details.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, Section 5 related-work discussion, and positioning relative to prior research are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an Author Contributions section after the conclusion, identifies Zhuang Li as senior author and research lead, and updates Xin Zhang's affiliation and email. The scientific narrative otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block and footnotes change, and the contribution statement causes subsequent text to reflow, shifting the appendix start from page 12 to page 13. Figures and tables retain their content and designs.

improvement.justification: v2 clarifies author attribution and updates affiliation information. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, so these administrative and layout edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
